# Antigua Real Estate Development (ARD)

> Antigua Real Estate Development (ARD) is a real estate company in Antigua Guatemala. We help foreign and local buyers find, buy and own property in Antigua and its surrounding villages (Ciudad Vieja, Jocotenango, San Pedro Las Huertas, Santa Lucia Milpas Altas, San Miguel Duenas, Pastores, San Juan del Obispo and the historic center). Services cover buying guidance, property management and AI tools for real estate agents. Buying with us is your choice, and expert help is described on the site.

## Services and core pages

- [Home](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/): Antigua Guatemala property for sale, listings and buyer guidance.
- [Services](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/services/): What ARD does for buyers, from search and viewings through closing and property management.
- [About](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/about/): Who runs ARD and how we work with clients.
- [Contact](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/contact/): Get in touch with ARD.
- [AI Agent for Realtors](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/ai-agent-for-realtors/): The AI automation ARD offers licensed real estate agents.
- [Notion for Real Estate](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/notion-for-real-estate/): How to run a real estate business out of a Notion CRM.
- [Relocation Checklist](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/relocation-checklist/): A free checklist for moving to Antigua Guatemala.

## Neighborhoods

- [Neighborhoods Overview](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/): All villages around Antigua compared for living.
- [Historic Center](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/historic-center/): Property in the center of Antigua.
- [Ciudad Vieja](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/ciudad-vieja/): A quiet village minutes south of Antigua.
- [Jocotenango](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/jocotenango/): Upscale village on the north edge of Antigua.
- [San Pedro Las Huertas](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/san-pedro-las-huertas/): Residential area with easy access to town.
- [San Miguel Duenas](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/san-miguel-duenas/): A growing village with lower land prices.
- [Pastores](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/pastores/): Traditional leather-goods town southwest of Antigua.
- [San Juan del Obispo](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/san-juan-del-obispo/): Quiet village with colonial character.
- [Santa Lucia Milpas Altas](https://antiguarealestatedevelopment.com/neighborhoods/santa-lucia-milpas-altas/): Cooler mountain town above Antigua.
